status: three-panel >=3-day temporal-persistence stress test frozen after x-y-time-only preflight and after partial >=1-day positive results
role: post-freeze exploratory temporal-stability stress test; not independent confirmation and cannot alter v0.3.8

provenance.interpretation_rule: Treat as a stress-test refinement of temporal stability, not independent confirmatory evidence.

excluded_panels.eidolon: 4/12 evaluable at >=3 days; below frozen gate

ecological_question: Does centered vertical organization remain individually predictive when all same-individual training sessions are at least three days from the target?

state_definition.session_time: median timestamp of valid speed×turn endpoints

estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.self_training: same-individual sessions in same cohort with absolute median-time lag >=3 days
estimator.common_weighting: equal-session self distribution over jointly supported cell×state strata, applied identically to self and other profiles

calibration.preserve: session time, x-y-time state and centered z remain with session block; exact label session-count multiset preserved
calibration.lag_rebuild: recompute >=3-day self training after every label permutation
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated common-cell identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.3_pass: All three structurally evaluable systems retain vertical individuality across >=3-day self-history separation.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Multi-day temporal persistence is mixed across systems.
decision_matrix.0_pass: The >=1-day signal does not persist to >=3 days in the structurally evaluable subset.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to P2016, Eidolon, or persistence beyond three days.

claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc stress test opened after partial >=1-day results.
Persistence over three days does not prove immutable intrinsic traits.
Longer than three-day persistence remains unresolved.
stop_rule: Do not change subset, 3-day lag, session-time definition, 5-km grid, speed2_turn2, centering, bins, 50-event support, expected n, B/seeds or pass criteria after output.
If exact n fails, invalidate rather than retune.
